summary: Iteration 51 focused pass on the NEW gap items: Partner Performance district/speciality filters, Ecommerce report platform/category filters + Revenue-by-Platform & Revenue-by-Month tables, ecommerce summary flatness regression, Orders tab order-status/payment-status dropdowns, inventory_movements.reference_id linkage, and the 'Terms used: <title> (vN)' footer on all 3 PDF types. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iter51_new_gaps.py (21 tests, 21 pass) and re-ran the existing suites (test_iter46_partners_ecommerce, test_iter46_terms_categories, test_iter47_api, test_iter48_api) => 99/99 pass. Frontend: verified Reports page filters + both new breakdown tables render real numbers with no crash (CRITICAL bug from prior run is FIXED), Ecommerce Orders tab dropdowns issue PUT 200 and persist across reload, and downloaded + text-parsed all 4 PDFs (Detailed Quotation, Kit Quotation, GST Invoice Combined, GST Invoice List) confirming the 'Terms used' line and NO 'TEST_' marker. Light smoke on Partners page, ProjectPartnerCard, CEO dashboard ecommerce section, Terms page — no regressions. Only minor issues remain (see below); nothing blocking.

minor.issue: summary.net_margin = total_revenue - total_commission and IGNORES COGS, while the per-item rows compute net_margin = revenue - commission - cost. The headline 'Net Margin' card therefore overstates margin and contradicts the table below it. Align the definitions (or rename the card to 'Revenue after Commission').

settlement_date is only stored because the frontend sends it; the backend does not auto-stamp settlement_date when payment_status transitions to 'settled' (an API-only client can set settled with no date). Also `update = {k:v for ... if v is not None}` silently drops explicit nulls, so a field can never be cleared (e.g. reverting settlement_date).

Endpoint does not exist (only platforms and listings have DELETE). An erroneously recorded order can never be removed — only status-changed to cancelled — and test data cannot be cleaned up, which is why the Orders tab now shows 14 leftover TEST_* orders.

Still open from iteration_50: soft-deleted (active=false) platforms are hidden in the Platforms tab but their orders remain listed with the platform name resolved, so the Ecommerce report platform breakdown shows 14 platforms while only 2 are visible in the UI.

ui_bugs.issue: React console error 'Encountered two children with the same key' on the Ecommerce report. chart_data rows are keyed by item.name, and the backend truncates names to 15 chars (r.platform[:15]), so platforms sharing a 15-char prefix (e.g. several 'TEST_Iter51_Pla...') collide and bars can be omitted. Use the index (or full name) as the React key.

Currency heuristic is value-based, not key-based: amounts <= 999 render with no ₹ symbol (Ecommerce report showed 'TOTAL COMMISSION 200'), and any count-like metric > 999 whose key does not contain count/staff/entries/logs/sites would be prefixed with ₹ (e.g. total_orders = 1200 would render '₹1,200'). Drive the format off the metric key instead.

issues: Date From / Date To still use the raw browser-native date input (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn calendar component used elsewhere in the app — inconsistent and shows US date order for an INR/India app.

design_issues.screen: Ecommerce / Reports / Partners / Terms (data hygiene, not code)
issues: Preview DB is heavily polluted by leftover test data from prior automated runs: 298 projects (mostly TEST_*), 14 TEST_* ecommerce orders, 2 TEST_* platforms still ACTIVE in the Platform dropdown, 9 delisted TEST listings, 5 TEST_* partners (all of them the only rows in the Partner Performance report, none with service_districts so the new District filter always returns 0 rows on real data), and two inactive 'Test Terms v1' T&C versions. Real numbers such as 'Return Rate 64.3%' are meaningless. Recommend a cleanup script for TEST_/Test prefixed docs.

action_items: Align ecommerce report summary.net_margin with the per-item definition (subtract COGS) or rename the card.
Auto-stamp settlement_date server-side when payment_status becomes 'settled' (do not rely on the client).
Add DELETE /api/ecommerce/orders/{id} (admin-only, restoring stock if the order was active) so bad orders / test data can be removed.
Fix duplicate React key in the Reports Visual Breakdown chart (key on index, not the 15-char truncated name).
Make formatSummaryValue key-driven so counts never get a ₹ prefix and sub-1000 amounts do.
Optional: purge TEST_*/Test* seed pollution (projects, partners, ecommerce platforms/listings/orders, T&C versions) so reports show meaningful data.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_report() is a single ~700-line function with 22 inline report branches; the partner_performance/ecommerce branches added this session push it further. Extract each report into its own module (e.g. reports/partner_performance.py) — the file is far beyond the 700-line guidance.

reports/ecommerce iterates `orders` twice (once for by_platform/by_item, once for by_month) duplicating the identical category-filter block — extract a single filtered-lines helper to avoid the two copies drifting.

Ecommerce order status transitions are only guarded by was_active/now_inactive; there is no state machine, so an order can go delivered -> placed and a cancelled order can be re-cancelled (harmless today because restore is guarded, but worth an explicit allowed-transition map).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows passed (2 low-severity console/format defects noted)

seed_data_creation: test_iter51_new_gaps.py creates and then deletes: 1 partner (TEST_Iter51_Partner_*) with speciality pump/civil + service_district TEST_District_51 and one assignment, 1 platform (TEST_Iter51_Plat_*), 1 listing and 1 order (TEST51-ORD-*). Orders/assignments cannot be deleted (no DELETE endpoint), so 4 TEST51-ORD-* orders remain in the DB from repeated runs. UI run also flipped one pre-existing TEST-UI-ORD-2 order to payment=settled / status=shipped.
test_credentials: admin@sensoper.com / Admin@123 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md) — login works, session cookie based
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 previously reported bugs are verified fixed: (1) Ecommerce report no longer white-screens and every summary key (total_revenue, total_commission, net_margin, total_orders, return_rate_pct, listings_live/draft/paused/delisted) is a scalar; (2) inventory_movements now carries reference_id == order id for both the sale (reference_type=ecommerce_order) and the restore (ecommerce_order_return) — verified directly against MongoDB in test_iter51_new_gaps.py; (3) Orders tab order-status-select-{id} / order-payment-select-{id} dropdowns work (PUT 200, persists after reload) and cancelled/returned restores stock with no double-restore; (4) the stale TEST_ invoice T&C template is gone and 'Standard Invoice Terms' (invoice), 'Standard Terms & Conditions' (quotation) and 'Standard AMC Terms' (amc) are the single active templates per category. New PDF footer confirmed by text-extracting the downloaded files (saved under /app/test_reports/pdfs/): Detailed Quotation + Kit Quotation both say 'Terms used: Standard Terms & Conditions (v1)', GST Invoice Combined and List both say 'Terms used: Standard Invoice Terms (v1)'; no TEST_ text in any. Partner Performance district/speciality and Ecommerce platform/category filters work in both API and UI. Note for UI scripts: Ecommerce page tabs are plain buttons — use data-testid="ecommerce-tab-orders" (NOT role=tab / get_by_text).
rca_of_the_issue: No new defects with a functional impact were found. The duplicate-React-key warning root-causes to reports chart_data being keyed by the backend-truncated 15-char label (server.py: {'name': r['platform'][:15]}), which collides for platforms sharing a prefix; the currency formatting oddity root-causes to formatSummaryValue deciding 'is this money?' from the numeric magnitude (v > 999) instead of the metric key.
